exclusions.null members of rows and tombstones: Node writes `null` for a tombstone field it has no value for (cwd, parent and owner ids); the core builds the tombstone without such a field, so a replay leaves null members out of both sides. Every non-null member of every row and tombstone is compared
exclusions.order of the rows and tombstones: recorded in the order Node's index lists them, but the core keeps each row in its own session's header (agent_registry/mod.rs:6-13), so it has no file order to compare; the rows and tombstones are compared as maps
exclusions.rows of the Lead pool (agent \"lead\"): Node leaves them out of the index file whenever the file is written again (its worker rows are projected without them), so no recorded list holds one; the core keeps the Lead's own row in its session header (agent_registry/lead_row.rs), which no pass removes, so a replay leaves them out of the list it compares
exclusions.the count of config loads: Node counts how often its reaper loads the config; the core reads its config from memory and has no load to count
exclusions.the rows as stored in the index file: a replay starts from `loaded`, the rows as Node's index handed them to the pass: its load settles a row stored as running whose session the manager does not run (restart-settlement.mjs:21, row-liveness) and fills absent fields, and the core settles such rows at its boot (agent_registry/restart.rs), not at a refresh. `rows`, the scenario's own input, is recorded beside it

keptWhole: per scenario: its rows, config, manager facts and scan sessions, the rows the index holds after the pass and the tombstones the pass wrote (every row and tombstone whole, recorded in Node's order), the scan verdicts

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

syntheticInputs: the worker rows and the scan sessions: the rows and sessions of terminal-reaper/stale-rows.test.mjs, every stamp an offset from the fixed clock
the session manager: answers only the in-flight, pending-message and runtime-stage facts a scenario names, no session record
